s: A solutions architect has implemented a SAML 2 0 federated identity solution with their company's on-premises identity provider (IdP) to authenticate users' access to the AWS environment. When the solutions architect tests authentication through the federated identity web portal, access to the AWS environment is granted However when test users attempt to authenticate through the federated identity web portal, they are not able to access the AWS environment Which items should the solutions architect check to ensure identity federation is properly configured? (Select THREE)
o: The 1AM user's permissions policy has allowed the use of SAML federation for that user
The 1AM roles created for the federated users' or federated groups' trust policy have set the SAML provider as the principal
Test users are not in the AWS Federated Users group in the company's IdP
The web portal calls the AWS STS AssumeRoleWithSAML API with the ARN of the SAML provider, the ARN of the 1AM role, and the SAML assertion from IdP
The on-premises IdP's DNS hostname is reachable from the AWS environment VPCs
The company's IdP defines SAML assertions that properly map users or groups in the company to 1AM roles with appropriate permissions

w.y: SAML federation does not use IAM users. Three things must be configured: the IAM role's trust policy must trust the SAML provider, the portal must call AssumeRoleWithSAML with the provider ARN, the role ARN and the assertion, and the IdP must map users or groups to roles in the assertion. The architect succeeding while test users fail points to the role mapping and trust setup, not to network reachability.

o.A: Federated users are not IAM users, so no IAM user permissions policy is involved in SAML federation.
o.B: Correct: the role trust policy must name the SAML provider as the federated principal so AssumeRoleWithSAML is allowed.
o.C: There is no required 'AWSFederatedUsers' group; group names come from your own IdP-to-role mapping.
o.D: Correct: AssumeRoleWithSAML needs the SAML provider ARN, the role ARN and the base64 SAML assertion.
o.E: AWS does not contact the IdP; the browser posts the assertion to AWS, so VPC reachability to the IdP is irrelevant.
o.F: Correct: the assertion's Role attribute must map the test users' groups to IAM roles, or they get no access.
